description: Standing Kegel guide: the hardest, most functional pelvic-floor squeeze, how it should feel upright, common mistakes, easier and harder versions.
intro: The standing Kegel trains the pelvic floor where it has to work in real life. Upright, the muscles lift against gravity and the weight of the organs above them, so this is the hardest version. It bridges lying practice and moments like coughing, lifting or standing up.
feel: You should feel a lift up and in from the base of the pelvis, then a full release, while legs, glutes and belly stay quiet. Knees stay soft and weight stays even on both feet. Watch for pushing down, breath holding or locked knees. If your hips tuck under or heels rise, other muscles took over.

mistakes.wrong: Locked knees and a tucked pelvis
mistakes.right: Unlock the knees and keep a neutral spine, weight over the middle of your feet.
If holds fade or your glutes clench, go back to lying or sitting and build there first.

mistakes.wrong: Gripping hard and forgetting to let go
mistakes.right: Use a moderate effort you can keep for the whole hold, then relax fully before the next rep.

easier: Hold a chair back or lean on a wall, and start with 2 to 3 second holds.
harder: Squeeze just before a cough, sneeze or lifting a bag, or add it to a slow sit-to-stand.
who: Runners, cyclists, lifters and anyone who leaks a little when coughing or jumping. Men with dribbling after urinating may find a squeeze after peeing helpful.
skip: If you feel heaviness or bulging in the vagina or pelvis, see a doctor or pelvic floor physiotherapist before adding load. The same goes for pelvic pain, recent surgery, a recent birth or an overactive pelvic floor, where relaxation comes first. Stop if it hurts.

faq.a: Standing puts your full body weight above the pelvic floor, so it lifts against more load while your legs and trunk keep you balanced.

faq.q: Should I squeeze before I cough or lift?
faq.a: A quick, gentle squeeze just before a cough, sneeze or lift is a common technique that may help reduce small leaks. Practice it lying and sitting first.
